condition.title: Problem
condition.p: When I try to move the cursor in the document, displays a Synchronizing with server warning message.

cause.title: Cause
cause.p: maintains a server-side representation of the document that it continuously synchronizes with the document being edited in the web browser. This synchronization uses asynchronous HTTP requests.
If HTTP requests have high latency, the next user interaction is blocked and a Synchronizing with server warning message appears.
The most common causes of high latency are:

ul.li: The network connection between the web browser and the server has a high latency.

The CSS used to render the XML document contains complex constructs that cause large parts of the document to be rendered again. Examples include:
The oxy_xpath() CSS function.
CSS selectors such as: subject selector, sibling selectors, positional selectors (e.g. :nth-child).
Extensions such as a StylesFilter that is slow to execute.

steps-informal.p:
To reduce this problem:
Use a faster network connection.
Rewrite the CSS to use more optimized selectors.
Optimize custom extensions that slow the application.
